game_title: Stride Selector – Fairy Ring Glade Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the herbalist ahead. Then check the stones value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the fairy lantern by solving code steps involving stones that move the herbalist forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the fairy lantern first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Fairy Ring Glade'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Fairy Ring Glade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
